summary: Blocked: this fixes a compilation error, not a test-executable behavioral regression. append_oneof references an undefined fields variable and its obsolete tuple representation. The fix iterates oneof.fields and passes each field.descriptor to can_field_derive_copy. The existing derive_copy module contains compile-time Copy trait checks, with no named Rust tests; the fix only adds allow(dead_code) there. The exact implementation reversal would prevent prost-build from compiling, so it cannot meet the confirmation gate requiring a built test target and an executed failing test. No builds or tests were run.
